title: Shawn C NDE 7719
content: This lesson took almost a life time to learn. When I was 12 yrs old, I watched as my father got killed in a horrible accident. He was not quite dead when I got to him. I grabbed his arm and tried to pull him free, but it was futile. As I was holding his arm we made eye contact and his last words were, 'I love you.' My other brothers were not at home at the time, it was just me. This was very traumatic, to say the least. After the initial loss, I became increasingly angry at God, angry as to why he let a 12 year old see such a sight. I can never forget something like that. I spent the next 38 years of my life doing my own will. I was not a bad person, but I always felt betrayed. One day, I was sitting at a red light when this blinding light came right through the windshield. A voice started talking to me. He said, 'I was giving you the chance to say good bye and to say l love you, something your brothers never had the chance to do.' Immediately I felt the anger I had inside disappear and I understood exactly what he was saying. I will never question him again. I don't know if these two things have a common thread, but I would welcome any input. My NDE happened about six months after the car incident. My NDE I don't know how long I was lying there, but my wife found me in the backyard. My skin-tone was gray in color and my lips were purple. She tried to revive me, but was unable to so. She called 911. After about 10 to 15 minutes they arrived and hooked me up to the monitor. They only showed flat lines. The hit me about five or six times with electric paddles, but nothing. They told my wife that I did not make it. Just as they were ready to pull the electric leads off of me, there was one beep. They watched as it went across the screen. Seconds later, there was one more beep. Prior to that time, I had been floating through total darkness with the feeling of indescribable love all around me. I finally came face to face with God. He looked into my eyes. I could tell that he knew everything I had ever done, things I was thinking at that moment, and things I would say or do in the future. You can't lie to God. He was very pleasant and said two things to me. He spoke telepathically from his eyes to mine. He said, 'I'm not ready for you yet. There are things I want you to do first.' Then I came back to consciousness. The doctors at the local hospital could not help, so they flew me to Allegheny General in Pittsburgh. I quit breathing in the helicopter on the way to hospital. I was dead on arrival. They were able to bring me back again. They told my family that without oxygen for so long, I would probably have severe brain damage. They also said that I had a stroke. I awoke the next morning feeling good. I was visited by a team of cardiologists. They showed me a monitor where they were watching my heart. The bottom third of my heart was shriveled up, blackish in color, and was not functioning at all. They said that they would have to do exploratory open-heart surgery the next morning to see if they could to fix it. I said ok and was completely calm when they told me. Anyone facing that would be a little bit nervous, but I wasn't. As I slept that night, I felt the presence of God come and reach into my chest. I awoke to see a team of cardiologists staring at the monitor, and they were bewildered. My heart was beating perfectly and was no longer shriveled up, nor discolored. They went over to a corner and quietly discussed what had happened. They said to me that they had no explanation. Although the word 'Miracle' was not used I'm sure that it had to cross their minds. What am I going to do with my life? I'm still not sure, but I do know that God is still in touch with me and steering me in a direction of which I am uncertain. He has shown me signs, but they seem a bit cryptic at this point

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Cardiac arrest (found with flatline), stroke, severe cardiac dysfunction with bottom third of heart 'shriveled up' and not functioning; planned exploratory open-heart surgery.
diagnosis.disease_name: Cardiac arrest with severe myocardial dysfunction; stroke (reported)
diagnosis.severity_description: Dead on arrival; required multiple defibrillation attempts; severe heart dysfunction; stroke; predicted severe brain damage due to prolonged hypoxia.
diagnosis.prognosis_given: Without oxygen for so long, would probably have severe brain damage; also told he had a stroke.
diagnosis.cardiac_function: Bottom third of heart described as 'shriveled up, blackish in color, and was not functioning at all.'

treatment.treatments_raw: CPR/attempted revival by wife; EMS cardiac monitoring; defibrillation with electric paddles 5-6 times; transported to local hospital; airlift to Allegheny General Hospital; resuscitated again after being dead on arrival; planned exploratory open-heart surgery (not performed due to recovery).
treatment.surgery_type: Exploratory open-heart surgery was planned for the next morning but apparently cancelled after heart normalized.
treatment.treatment_stopped_reason: Heart function normalized before planned surgery; clinicians had 'no explanation.'

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: Overnight (between cardiology assessment and the next morning).
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Cardiology team showed him a monitor indicating the bottom third of the heart was nonfunctional and discolored; next morning cardiologists observed on the monitor that the heart was beating perfectly and no longer shriveled/discolored; physicians stated they had no explanation. (Stroke mentioned by doctors but no imaging details provided.)
remission_outcome.physician_quote: They said to me that they had no explanation.
remission_outcome.tissue_regeneration_detail: Previously nonfunctioning, discolored portion of heart appeared normal and functioning by the next morning per cardiology monitor observation.

turner_factors.emotional_release_details: After a blinding-light/voice experience at a red light, he reports the anger toward God he carried for decades 'disappear[ed]' immediately.
turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Anger at God resolved; reports meeting God in NDE; felt God's presence reaching into his chest; says God is still in touch and steering him; received signs.
turner_factors.purpose_details: God told him: 'I'm not ready for you yet. There are things I want you to do first.'

pre_illness_state.pre_illness_description: At age 12 he witnessed his father's traumatic death and carried anger at God and feelings of betrayal for decades ('next 38 years').
pre_illness_state.loss_description: Father killed in a horrible accident when patient was 12; patient present and heard last words.
pre_illness_state.conflict_description: Anger at God for allowing him to witness the accident; sense of betrayal.
pre_illness_state.patient_causal_belief: He implies a connection between long-held anger/relationship with God and later experiences, but does not explicitly link this to the cardiac event.

existential_shift.identity_shift_description: Shift from decades of anger/betrayal toward trust in God and openness to guidance.
existential_shift.surrender_description: Reports being completely calm when told he needed exploratory open-heart surgery; also states he will 'never question' God again after the earlier voice/light experience.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: Anger at God dissolved after a perceived divine explanation; later NDE included meeting God and receiving a directive to return because there were things to do.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: Blinding light and voice at a red light reframed his father's death and immediately removed his anger; later NDE encounter with God.
existential_shift.transformation_timing: The anger-release experience occurred ~6 months before the NDE/cardiac arrest; heart normalization occurred after NDE and overnight in hospital.

anomalous_experience.experience_description: During apparent death/flatline he floated through darkness with indescribable love, came face to face with God, and was told telepathically he was not ready and had things to do; also earlier blinding light and voice while at a red light.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: NDE occurred during cardiac arrest; earlier voice/light incident ~6 months before NDE.
anomalous_experience.message_content: I'm not ready for you yet. There are things I want you to do first.

correspondential_markers.closed_will_description: Long-standing anger at God and sense of betrayal after traumatic loss.
correspondential_markers.correspondence_notes: Narrative emphasizes anger/heart closure followed by heart-related crisis and subsequent opening/trust; however, this is interpretive and not medically causal in the text.
correspondential_markers.resolution_type: Resolution of decades-long anger toward God and renewed trust/connection preceding the later cardiac event and subsequent rapid recovery.

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Reported flatline with prolonged downtime and predicted brain damage, plus severe observed myocardial dysfunction that normalized overnight per cardiology team, described as unexplained.
validation.extraction_notes: Cardiac findings are described qualitatively (no EF, enzymes, ECG/echo details). Stroke is mentioned without imaging specifics. Verification relies on narrative report of monitor findings and physician statements.

analysis.case_summary: After decades of anger toward God following childhood trauma, the experiencer reports a blinding-light/voice event that dissolved the anger. About six months later he suffered cardiac arrest with reported flatline and was resuscitated, had a reported stroke, and cardiologists observed severe nonfunctioning, discolored heart tissue that normalized overnight; physicians reportedly had no explanation. He links the recovery to an NDE and perceived divine presence.
key_healing_factors: Anomalous experiences (voice/light incident; NDE encounter with God)
Spiritual connection/faith strengthened and ongoing sense of guidance
Marked calm/surrender in face of planned open-heart surgery
Social support (wife initiated emergency response; family involved)
unique_features: Reported resuscitation after flatline and being declared not alive
Transfer to Allegheny General Hospital; reported dead on arrival with second resuscitation
Overnight normalization of previously nonfunctioning, discolored portion of heart observed on monitor
Two-step anomalous sequence: pre-NDE voice/light experience followed by NDE and cardiac recovery
analysis.analysis_notes: This is primarily a near-death experience narrative with an associated rapid cardiac recovery; exact medical diagnosis (e.g., myocardial infarction, cardiomyopathy, stunning) and the modality of imaging/monitor are not specified.
